def solve(case):
    # validate
    if not isinstance(case, dict) or "nodes" not in case or "required_symbols" not in case:
        raise ValueError("Invalid case: missing nodes or required_symbols")
    nodes_list = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    nodes = {}
    children = {}
    for nd in nodes_list:
        nid = nd.get("id")
        if not nid or not isinstance(nid, str):
            raise ValueError("Node missing id")
        if nid in nodes:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate node id")
        nodes[nid] = nd
        children.setdefault(nid, [])  # ensure list even if leaf
    # build children mapping
    for nd in nodes_list:
        pid = nd.get("parent")
        if pid is not None:
            if pid not in nodes:
                raise ValueError("Parent not found")
            children.setdefault(pid, []).append(nd["id"])
    # sort candidate ids
    candidate_ids = sorted(nodes.keys(), key=lambda nid: (-nodes[nid]["depth"], nid))
    removed_set = set()
    removed_order = []
    for nid in candidate_ids:
        if nid in removed_set:
            continue
        nd = nodes[nid]
        # check removable boolean
        if not nd.get("removable", False):
            continue
        if nd.get("symbol") in required_symbols:
            continue
        # check if any child is retained (not removed)
        has_retained_child = any(cid not in removed_set for cid in children.get(nid, []))
        if has_retained_child:
            continue
        # remove
        removed_set.add(nid)
        removed_order.append(nid)
    # retained ids sorted (string order)
    retained_ids = sorted([nid for nid in nodes if nid not in removed_set])
    return {"removed_node_ids": removed_order, "retained_node_ids": retained_ids}
